propositions: Core reconciler client/transport parameters are passed unannotated, so mypy cannot enforce that the Backend port declares every member the core calls.
Annotating parameters as TicketTransport imported via the runtime-only rebar_reconciler shim path is silently widened to Any by ignore_missing_imports, enforcing nothing while looking rigorous.
Fixing enforcement requires both annotating as the port AND importing it by a mypy-resolvable relative path (from ._backend import), verified by reveal_type not returning Any.
The _TransportPortMeta metaclass is not the cause of static blindness; a controlled probe holding the import path constant shows the metaclass-bearing Protocol is attribute-checked normally.

mypy is strictly stronger than the existing AST audit because it flags capability members like add_comment that hasattr-based checks cannot see; such sites resolve via composed capability views, not by adding members to the port body or reverting to Any.
Promoting _engine through the disallow_untyped_defs ratchet would not prevent the a357 defect class, since Any satisfies the ratchet while remaining blind at port boundaries.
